name: Brightcom Group Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2010, Brightcom Group Ltd (formerly Lycos Internet Ltd) offers digital marketing solutions to businesses, agencies and online publishers worldwide[1]
keyPoints:
Business Segments
1) Ad-Tech & Digital Marketing (91% in H1 FY25 vs 93% in FY22): [1] [2] The company offers digital marketing solutions including Ad campaigns in video, banners, email, search, social, mobile marketing, display advertising, connected TV advertising, etc to businesses, agencies, and online publishers globally. [3] [4]

pros: Stock is trading at 0.28 times its book value
Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 12.7% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 278 days.
